stem:
Meena measures the temperature of warm milk in a steel vessel using a laboratory thermometer at her home in Pune.
Which method gives the correct reading?

options.text: Dip only the tip of the thermometer in the milk and read it immediately.
Immerse the bulb fully in the milk without touching the vessel, wait until the column stops rising, and read at eye level with the bulb still in the milk.
Rest the bulb on the bottom of the vessel so the thermometer stays steady, then read.
Take the thermometer out of the milk, wait for one minute, and then read the column.

teacher.key_rationale: Correct technique: bulb fully immersed, not touching the vessel, vertical, reading taken at eye level after the column stops rising, with the thermometer kept in the liquid. A reads too early with poor immersion; C touches the vessel bottom, giving the vessel's temperature; D removes the thermometer so the column falls.
